description: Search Penopta project context in chat and keep ChatGPT/Codex threads in sync.

skills.name: penopta-context
skills.description: Answer questions about Penopta projects, threads, and activity stats using read MCP tools (list, search, get context, get stats). Use for "what has X been working on", project status, usage/effort stats, search, verify, or diagnose - not for hourly or bulk sync.

skills.name: penopta-hourly-sync
skills.description: Run one Penopta hourly or on-demand bulk sync only: known_projects, make_projects_available, tracked_projects, and sync_threads. Use for scheduled hourly runs or an explicit "sync Penopta now" request - not for asking what someone worked on.

interface.shortDescription: Keep ChatGPT project threads in sync with Penopta for search, context, and handoffs.
interface.longDescription: Penopta connects ChatGPT to your Penopta workspace so agent project work stays searchable and shareable. After you sign in with Penopta, ChatGPT can verify the connection, discover projects, sync opted-in project threads, pull project context into chat, and push a single conversation on demand. Identity and org come from OAuth — no API key to paste. Transcript sync only covers projects you choose to track in Penopta; private projects named with a P: or Private: prefix are never registered or synced.
defaultPrompt: What threads has Sean been working on?
How much have I been working this week?
Show which projects Penopta is tracking.
Run the hourly Penopta sync now.
